name: Tour Workspace Quick Configurator
title: Workspace Quick Configurator
description: Interactive workspace track picker rendered inside Guided Tour EmbeddedComponent steps, emitting chooseBranch and completeStep callbacks for live TourSession branching.
functionalRequirements: Displays 3 clickable workspace tracks (Explore Data, Collaborate with Sage, Manage & Build) with keyboard-accessible selection cards and completion actions that emit 'chooseBranch' (with payload { choiceKey }) and 'completeStep' events through callbacks.OnEvent.
technicalDesign: React component receiving standard MJ ComponentSpec props (data, step, callbacks). Uses useState hooks directly from the MJ sandbox runtime, styled with --mj-* design tokens and safe fallbacks, and dispatches callbacks.OnEvent('chooseBranch', { choiceKey }) and callbacks.OnEvent('completeStep', { choiceKey, completed: true }).

dataRequirements.description: Operates purely on InputProps/data passed by the EmbeddedComponent tour step renderer.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: Optional heading displayed above the workspace options
properties.defaultValue: Where would you like to focus first?

properties.name: tracks
properties.description: Optional array of track descriptors { key, title, subtitle }

events.name: chooseBranch
events.description: Emitted when the user picks a track and advances to the corresponding branch step (payload: { choiceKey: string })

events.name: completeStep
events.description: Emitted when the user confirms completion of the configurator step

usageExample: <TourWorkspaceQuickConfigurator data={{ heading: 'Choose your starting workspace' }} callbacks={{ OnEvent: (type, payload) => console.log(type, payload) }} />
